declared_before: any V9 training run or any V9 evaluation
when: once, after all six confirmatory runs completed their 24,000 updates and their development evaluations; each checkpoint is evaluated once

symbolic.not_evaluated: bind and shifted (S6 phase data, draft 4.1)
symbolic.decoding: frozen evaluate.symbolic_eval, greedy, frozen eager fixed-size decoding for dense/flat models (V8 fast path), strict verifier

text.split: V8 test split, families edu and ts, 256 documents each, frozen fixed_text seed 88200 (identical documents across arms)
text.caveat: No fresh text documents exist. V8 evaluated these documents; no V9 model trains on them.

tests.H3: hierarchy (A_delayed) vs A_flat, success on v9test standard. Per seed: McNemar exact and paired item bootstrap (10,000). Pooled: per-item difference averaged over the two seeds, bootstrap interval over items; p from a two-sided sign-flip randomization test (10,000) on the same per-item differences. Supported iff the point estimate is positive on both seeds, the pooled interval excludes 0 above, and the Holm-adjusted p < .05.
tests.H4: A_flat vs A_delayed text NLL on the 512 documents of both families pooled (sum of numerators over sum of targets); per family reported. Per seed: paired document bootstrap (10,000). Pooled: per-document numerators averaged over seeds. p from a sign-flip randomization test on document differences. Supported iff on both seeds flat is lower by >= .02 nats in point estimate with the per-seed interval excluding 0, and the Holm-adjusted p < .05.
tests.H5: A_delayed vs A_alpha0, success on v9test standard, same procedure and decision rule as H3.
tests.family: Holm correction over {H3, H4, H5} (draft 13.2, S1 stage).
tests.secondary_not_in_family: A_alpha0 vs A_flat on standard; A_delayed vs A_alpha0 on hard10; all suites and per-family text reported per seed with intervals.
